create_mkldnn_module: create a PyTorch module and convert it to MKLDNN format for optimized inference using to_mkldnn
build_mkldnn_linear: build an MKLDNN-optimized linear layer by wrapping a torch.nn.Linear module with MkldnnLinear
build_mkldnn_conv2d: build an MKLDNN-optimized 2D convolution layer by wrapping a torch.nn.Conv2d module with MkldnnConv2d
build_mkldnn_batch_norm: build an MKLDNN-optimized batch normalization layer by wrapping a torch.nn.BatchNorm2d module with MkldnnBatchNorm
test_mkldnn_conversion: test converting a PyTorch neural network module to MKLDNN format and running inference with to_mkldnn
